ينتقون (form VIII)
# يَنْتَقُونَ (yantaqūna) /jan.ta.quː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
# يُنْتَقَوْنَ (yuntaqawna) /jun.ta.qaw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَى (intaqā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
